_____
 Coram :- Sarang V. Kotwal, J.
Date :- 14 June 2024 P.C. :-
1.

The Applicants are seeking anticipatory bail in connection with C.R.No.202 of
2024 registered at Andheri Police Station, Mumbai, on 08.04.2024, under Sections
406, 420, 465, 467, 468 and 471 r/w. 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Heard Mr. Aabad Ponda, learned senior counsel for the applicants, Ms. Ranjana
Humane, learned App for the State and Mr. Umeshchandra Yadav Patil, learned
counsel for the Intervenor.
Digitally signed by Vinod Vinod Bhaskar Bhaskar Gokhale Gokhale

3.
By the previous order dated 17.04.2024 the applicant were protected by ad-interim order and they were directed to attend the concerned police station from 07.05.2024 to 09.05.2024.

Learned APP,
on instructions of the investigating officer, makes a statement that the applicants have attended the concerned police station and have co-operated with the investigation.
She further makes a statement that the investigating agency does not want to arrest the present applicants in connection with the present subject matter.
The statement is recorded and accepted.
4. In view of this statement, learned senior counsel for the applicants does not press this application as there is no apprehension of arrest.
5. The application is, therefore, disposed of as not pressed.

(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
